source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check link status for 2 situation: without connect and with connect 
cmd: mst status -v
(need to download package)
2. Loop-back all MLNX ports, and then check Physical state via cmd: ibstat |grep -i "mlx" -A10 |egrep 'mlx|state'

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Run mst status -v and filtered ibstat after physical loopback.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Device list and physical-state lines for disconnected/connected confirmation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly notices the physical loopback dependency but compresses both states into filtered output.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; requires per-port identity/state matrix, operator loopback control, traffic isolation and final removal evidence.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL; identifies operator-provided variables and target plus shell quoting concern.

original_test_intent: Verify every specified Mellanox device and port is enumerated correctly and reports the expected physical state both disconnected and with an approved loopback installed.
original_method: Collect `mst status -v` and `ibstat` in two separately identified physical configurations: no connection and operator-installed loopback on every mapped MLNX port, then confirm final device/log health after removal.
manual_activity: A qualified person must identify each physical connector, verify it is not carrying protected traffic, install the approved loopback, document the connection, and remove it. The agent can automate the complete read-only collection around those manual state transitions.
required_inputs: MFT/mst and infiniband-diags/ibstat versions and hashes or approved package source
Expected device inventory and disconnected/loopback state for each port
Correct loopback media and insertion/removal SOP
Traffic isolation, OOB access and operator confirmation timestamps
safety_requirements: Do not insert a loopback into an ambiguous, active or production-connected port.
Require explicit operator confirmation for each connection-state transition and retain port identity evidence.
Use read-only mst/ibstat collection; do not reset, reconfigure or retrain ports.
Preserve complete outputs rather than only grep-selected state lines.
Stop on damaged media, wrong mapping, unexpected traffic or link fault; no automatic retry or port reset.
agent_execution_scope: Validate packages and map all intended devices/functions/ports.
Collect complete baseline mst/ibstat and logs with no connection.
After operator confirmation, collect complete per-port loopback state and correlate it to the physical record.
After operator removal, verify inventory/link/log health and report observed states without a formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve package versions, map, state matrix, media and traffic window.
Install/remove and document physical loopback hardware.
Evaluate the per-port matrix and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The tools are appropriate, but its single filtered command cannot prove two distinct connection states or every port and may hide device identity and error context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain `mst status -v` and `ibstat`; run full captures once per named state and per mapped port, then derive a comparison without discarding raw output.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both source commands, the all-port loopback requirement and 3/3-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Drive an evidence matrix keyed by adapter serial/BDF, MST device, HCA/port and physical connector across DISCONNECTED, LOOPBACK_CONNECTED and POST_REMOVAL states.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Approved Mellanox adapter and fabric mode where mst and ibstat expose the required state.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record exact MFT, infiniband-diags, driver, firmware and OS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA MFT mst documentation and the installed ibstat manual for the approved package versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds state separation, stable mapping, full raw output, physical confirmation and cleanup evidence; no tool substitution.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every MLNX port and both required situations remain covered.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-port expected-state matrix and loopback topology.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: `mst status` identifies devices but does not alone prove every physical fabric port or cable path.

project_override_considerations: A project may define a subset only through an explicit approved coverage plan. The report must identify tested ports and cannot claim all source ports if fewer were looped back.
expected_evidence: Package/tool versions and full adapter/function/port mapping
Complete mst/ibstat outputs for disconnected state
Operator-confirmed physical loopback record and complete output for every mapped port
Expected-versus-observed matrix, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure consistently requires two link situations and physical loopback across all MLNX ports. Its broad criterion is incomplete but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is understandable and can proceed when project packages, map, expectations and operator support are supplied; missing readiness inputs do not make it permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Confirms the hybrid physical/automated nature but expands evidence beyond grep output.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION and retains its physical, traffic and state-matrix safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes each port/state independently traceable and separates operator action, automated Tool Result and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a single loopback or filtered state line from being generalized to all ports and ensures the disconnected state and cleanup are actually evidenced.
independent_technical_reasoning: The physical loopback is an indispensable environment transition that software cannot perform or truthfully claim. Once the operator establishes each state, the core device/status capture is automatable, matching the V3.1 PARTIAL definition.

no_automatic_retry: Do not reconnect, reset, retrain or repeat failed collection automatically; preserve the exact state and request operator review.
